summary:
Implementation plan for the 11 compiled gameplay requirements and the 5-variety gem sprite sheet:
1. Block breaking duration & hold-to-break animation with progressive cracks.
2. Fix block placement position reset by decoupling engine re-mounts from inventory state.
3. Ground-level spawn alignment and dedicated indestructible Spawn Door block with leave-world punch interaction.
4. Fullscreen toggle in-game menu option.
5. Fixed 3-slot recent-item toolbar with automatic empty slot restoration and separate Fist control.
6. Exact in-world texture scaling for toolbar and inventory item representations.
7. Lock placement non-overlap clamping and strict owner-only destruction returning the lock to inventory.
8. Official 5-gem variety sprite sheet extraction with transparent background removal.
